description: A Python script that generates Lua code based on a JSON configuration file and a template. It includes a GUI built with Tkinter for selecting the config file and triggering code generation.

classes.name: App
classes.description: A Tkinter-based GUI application class for selecting configuration files and generating Lua code.

methods.name: generate_lua_code
methods.description: Main function that reads a JSON config and a Lua template, then generates a customized Lua script based on the config data.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for the App class, sets up the GUI components.

methods.name: browse_config
methods.description: Opens a file dialog to select a JSON configuration file and updates the GUI.

methods.name: run_generation
methods.description: Triggers the Lua code generation process and shows success or error messages.
